title: SCE 2.8 Reactive Probe - IMDS Protection Weakening Detection and Response
description: Security Chaos Engineering experiment validating reactive controls for EC2 IMDS protection weakening. Simulates Attack 1.3 (Weaken IMDS Configuration - TTP T1562.001) and Attack 2.3 (IMDS Access - TTP T1552.005). Validates reactive controls automatically revert IMDS to secure baseline, attach session revocation policy, and publish alerts. Corresponds to ADT nodes 2.6 and 2.7.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Reactive controls automatically mitigate IMDS configuration weakening

probes.name: Verify reactive controls executed within 30-minute SLA

method.name: Deploy experiment infrastructure with secure IMDS baseline

rollbacks.name: Cleanup experiment resources via CloudFormation deletion
